title: Testing Your MCP Connection with Real Business Central Questions and Best Practices (BLOG 4 OF 4)
summary: Testing a Business Central MCP setup by running real-world business queries through Claude, with two practical scenarios (project budget analysis and inventory visualization) and best practices for security, agent interaction, and maintenance.
key_points: AI agents connected via MCP can answer complex business questions in plain English by making multiple API calls and generating visual charts automatically
Custom API pages are needed when standard BC APIs lack required data, like project planning lines for budget analysis
Conversational queries enable iterative refinement and follow-up analysis without rebuilding reports each time
Security requires read-only configurations by default, no stored secrets, purpose-specific setups, and audit reviews
Complex multi-step analyses that traditionally took 15-30 minutes can be completed in seconds through natural language prompts
features: Interactive chart rendering in Claude Desktop

quotes.text: The value is not in reading individual records. It is in asking business questions and getting visual, actionable answers in seconds.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the transformation from traditional report building to agentic query-driven analysis
